mechanism_evidence.reference: task_graph + timeline consumption real, byte-exact oracle (ADR-019)
mechanism_evidence.metal: Tier0 + timeline hardware-verified, dev-metal preset, ctest 20/20 passed (2026-08-21)
mechanism_evidence.vulkan: Tier0 + Tier1 + timeline compile-review-only, no Linux/NVIDIA execution evidence

E002.backends: metal (real hardware, CachedObject lowering) + reference (byte-exact oracle); vulkan compile-review-only

E004.backends: metal (real hardware, CertifiedPinned/Universe Direct + DiscoverThenLease HostAssisted) + reference (all Direct); SoftwarePaged/FaultManaged honestly Unsupported on both; vulkan compile-review-only

E007.backends: metal (real hardware, genuine Direct table-dereference lowering, gpu_addresses capability confirmed present) + reference (zero code changes needed); vulkan compile-review-only, real descriptor indexing explicitly deferred

E009.backends: metal (real hardware, indirect dispatch + atomic-counter stream compaction) + reference; vulkan compile-review-only, reusing ADR-022's existing dispatch_task_ring_and_tier1

E012.backends: metal (real hardware, 3 of 4 graph shapes: linear chain, independent branches via multi-encoder hazard tracking, fork-join via MTLFence) + reference; cross-queue/representation-transition/external-present shapes honestly Unsupported/Deferred; vulkan compile-review-only

runner.note: Parses the five experiments' ctest results into a single vg.summary/v1 run; Vulkan is recorded as a fixed compile-review-only sample per experiment, never executed, never reported as passed.

gap_pattern_historical: Before TASK-B10-B17 (see ADR-023/TASK-B9), all five gate experiments had zero implementation of their required core capability. Every gap identified there has a corresponding real implementation and ADR listed above.
unsupported_or_deferred: E004 SoftwarePaged/FaultManaged: honestly Unsupported on metal and reference (ADR-025) -- pre-authorized by the backend design docs, not a gap
E009 GPU-side hardware timestamps: out of scope, CPU-side timing only (ADR-026)
E012 cross-queue / representation-transition / external-present graph shapes: honestly Unsupported/Deferred (ADR-027), 1 of 4 shapes
E002 multi-hop pointer chains: single-hop only verified end-to-end (ADR-028)
E007 real Vulkan descriptor indexing (VK_EXT_descriptor_indexing/nonuniformEXT) as the bindless comparison baseline: explicitly out of scope, the largest single deferral in the whole plan (ADR-029)

gate_closure_criterion.summary: Metal+reference real hardware results + Vulkan compile-review-only evidence, an explicit documented deviation from the roadmap's literal both-backend-results text, due to permanent Vulkan hardware unavailability on this development machine.
gate_closure_criterion.status: satisfied -- all five experiments (E002/E004/E007/E009/E012) have real, hardware-verified Metal+reference results plus documented Vulkan compile-review-only mappings, per ADR-025 through ADR-029
